extensionDescription.message: Arc-like tweaks for Zen: the sidebar over fullscreen video, only this space's tabs in the address bar, a window on Cmd+Tab.

fullscreenSidebarDescription.message: In compact mode, the sidebar slides out when you move the pointer to the left edge of a fullscreen video.

workspaceTabsTitle.message: Only this space's tabs in the address bar

workspaceTabsDescription.message: “Switch to tab” no longer offers tabs from other spaces, so Enter opens the address in the current space instead of jumping away.

reopenOnActivateDescription.message: When Zen has no windows left, switching to it opens a new one, just like clicking its Dock icon.

loadError.message: Zen Tweaks can't reach the browser. Set extensions.experiments.enabled to true in about:config and restart Zen.
